messages:
hana-peopleops: Quick late-breaker — our short compliance attestation window ends TOMORROW EOD (May 22 23:59 UTC). If you havent completed the attestation form and uploaded any required evidence, please do so now: https://redwood.example.com/attest-quick. 

hana-peopleops: This is the last org-wide reminder. Team leads: double-check your direct reports before EOD. If you manage external vendors, confirm theyre in the form.

devon-eng: Heads up from eng — we'll submit consolidated squad bundles by 20:00 UTC. If you still need to hand over artifacts to a lead, DM me now.

kris-security: Minimal evidence recap: infra = CMDB screenshot OR asset-export CSV; apps = brief dataflow (PNG/PDF) + encryption screenshot; third-party integrations = minimal contract excerpt + data classification note. Upload to the Evidence Locker and tag "for review" if you want a quick look.

mila-privacy: If you haven't completed the annual privacy micro-course, the attestation form will show the training link. Please complete the ~15-min module *before* you attest — ideally by tonight to avoid delays.

remind-bot: Reminder scheduled: final "Attestation due EOD" ping will post in #general in 2 hours and an email digest at 21:00 UTC.

hana-peopleops: If you need an emergency extension for a contractor or late hire, leads must file the extension request in the form by 21:30 UTC. We can only grant a short grace window.

kris-security: For urgent audit-related uploads, include "audit:urgent" in the filename and tag @kris-security in the form; we'll prioritize.

devon-eng: Thanks all — squad leads, I'll post the consolidated upload list in #eng in 30 mins.

hana-peopleops: TL;DR: attest + evidence due May 22 23:59 UTC; training first; extension requests to be filed by 21:30 UTC. Huge thanks to teams who already finished this week. :heart:
